I was just thinking about this company called Questrade. It's a discount brokerage, stock trading company. Years ago, when they were new, they enticed me to sign up with them. Originally, they advertised themselves as a real honorable company, with no inactivity fees, no hidden charges, etc.

But then amidst my life I left my account dormant. I just got out of stock trading, and ignored the whole thing. Well, turns out, Questrade fucked me over during that time. I went back onto my account, and discovered I had lost a great deal of money. (Well, to me, anyway). Questrade, without having my approval, changed all of the terms of their service.

While my account was on hiatus they started charging me inactivity fees, when originally they promised not to. Then they charged me interest for my last stock trades. It was really scammy how they did it. Basically, they allow you to trade American, or Canadian stocks. But if you do not convert your money before hand, into either American or Canadian, they treat it as a loan, and charge you an exorbitant interest rate.

It annoyed me. The interest and inactivity fees racked up. So I decided I wanted to withdraw what little money I had left. I tried to take out something around $90.00. I put in a request and had to wait what felt like few days. After that they denied me. They said I couldn't withdraw because I didn't have enough moeny in my account.

So, I was required to put in more money to withdraw my money. What the fuck? Is that not my money? They were blocking me from withdrawing my own cash, unless I put in more cash. I was wary of them, so I didn't do that. I had a feeling that if I put in more money they would have just claimed it to cover some other bogus charges.

Overall, I had a horrific experience with Questrade. If you Google them you will have difficulty finding any poor reviews though because they have shills going around singing praise about the company, and over rating them on websites. You read the comments and it reads like an advert. But when I originally used Questrade the service was abysmal. It was next to non-existent.

I know that I should have been more prudent, but they seemed like a legit company. I was used to a certain level of service from my bank. The cost of lower priced trades really fucked me over. All the hidden fees and charges outstripped any advantage I gained -- which was none.

TL;DR - Questrade is a piece of shit.
